metadata.title: Schema and Contract Governance

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for governing schemas and message contracts so that producers and consumers interpret integration messages consistently and safely.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Schema registries, contract definitions, versioning frameworks, and compatibility validation mechanisms.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Pattern for establishing semantic trust through explicit schema and contract governance in integration systems.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Schema and contract governance assumes baseline integration identity, ownership, and accountability.

metadata.remarks: Schema and Contract Governance defines trust properties required to prevent semantic drift, silent incompatibility, and misinterpretation of integration messages. This pattern treats schemas as authoritative contracts and does not address transport delivery, cryptographic protection, or replay behavior.

components.title: Schema Authority and Ownership
components.description: Defines authoritative ownership for schemas and contracts used in integration.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Masquerading through unauthorized or misleading schema definitions.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Access control restricting who may define or modify schemas.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Schema and contract definitions are managed by authorized owners.
Policies define schema ownership and approval requirements.

components.title: Schema Versioning and Compatibility
components.description: Controls how schemas evolve over time and manages compatibility between producers and consumers.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Manipulation of data structures to cause silent consumer failure or misinterpretation.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Lifecycle controls governing schema evolution and deprecation.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Schema evolution features are constrained to prevent unsafe compatibility changes.

components.title: Semantic Validation and Contract Enforcement
components.description: Ensures messages conform to agreed schemas and semantic constraints.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Delivery of malformed or semantically incorrect messages to bypass controls.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Validation of message content against authoritative contracts.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Integrity checks validate messages against defined schemas.

components.title: Contract Observability and Change Audit
components.description: Provides traceability of schema usage and contract changes over time.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Suppression or obfuscation of evidence related to schema or contract changes.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Audit logging of contract definition and usage.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Schema definition and usage events are logged.
Audit review supports investigation of semantic integration issues.
